toxicMaterial.name: Phyllobates terribilis skin poison
toxicMaterial.description: A skin-associated mixture of defensive alkaloids. Batrachotoxin is a documented component, but evidence about the isolated compound must not be generalized to the complete skin material.
toxicMaterial.ecologicalRoleSummary: Supports passive chemical defense against predators.

evidence.notes: Captive status materially affects toxin presence and must be reported with exposure claims.

components.summary: Batrachotoxin has been detected at high levels in the skin of wild Phyllobates terribilis; this record does not assign a comparable percentage of the complete skin material.
